title_en: At the former aviation field, 1+1 apartment with perfect floor plan for sale!!!
description_en: At the Former Aviation Field, 1+1 Apartment for Sale with Perfect Layout!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a gross area of ​​68.08 m2 and a net area of ​​58.86 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom, a balcony, and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is West, allowing light and views. Currently, the construction is in the construction phase on the 5th floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 2 years.
